workflow_details.description: Add information that will help to differentiate this workflow from another.
workflow_details.title: Workflow Details

data_source.description: Select one of your configured data sources.
Select one of your configured data sources.

time_range.description: Choose the period of time to analyze.
time_range.title: Time Range

subject_group_name.description: ⚠️ The use of a group with mixed subtypes could lead to unexpected results
subject_group_name.title: Subject Group Name

include_subject_additional.description: Whether or not to include the subject's free-form `additional` JSON
include_subject_additional.title: Include Subject Additional

groupers.description:
Specify how the data should be grouped to create the views for your dashboard.
            This field is optional; if left blank, all the data will appear in a single view.

trajectory_segment_filter.description: Filter track data by setting limits on track segment length, duration, and speed. Segments outside these bounds are removed, reducing noise and to focus on meaningful movement patterns.

covariates.description: One entry per covariate to attach. Choose 'Image' for a single image (e.g. elevation) or 'Image Collection' for a time-matched covariate (e.g. NDVI); add as many as you need.
covariates.title: Covariates

export_format.description: Which file(s) to write with all covariate labels. 'both' (default) writes CSV + Parquet; 'none' skips export.
export_format.title: Export Format

oneOf.title: Day of the year as a number (example: 365)
Day of the month as a number (example: 31)

ImageCollectionCovariate.description: One covariate sampled from a GEE image collection at the time closest to each segment (e.g. NDVI).

name.description: Name for this covariate's column in the output, e.g. 'ndvi'.
name.title: Name

image_collection_id.description: Full Earth Engine ImageCollection asset ID (a path, NOT a band name), e.g. 'MODIS/061/MYD13A1'.
image_collection_id.title: Image Collection Id

band.description: Band to sample from the collection, e.g. 'NDVI'.
band.title: Band

time_column.description: Datetime column used to pick the temporally closest image, e.g. 'segment_start'.
time_column.title: Time Column

image_stack.description: Number of images to stack around each segment's time. 0 = just the single nearest-in-time image. N = the nearest image plus the N images before and N after it (2N+1 total), combined per segment with 'stack_reducer'. Increase it to smooth noise or fill gaps where the nearest image is cloud-masked.
image_stack.title: Image Stack

stack_reducer.description: How to combine a multi-image stack (image_stack > 0): 'mean'/'median'/'min'/'max' return one value per segment (ignoring masked images); 'list' returns the full list of per-image values. With a stack, '<name>_img_date' always holds the list of dates involved. Ignored when image_stack = 0.
stack_reducer.title: Stack Reducer

reducer.description: Spatial reducer: how the pixels under each (buffered) segment are combined into one value (mean, median, mode, min, max, sum, stdDev, first).
reducer.title: Spatial Reducer

scale.description: Sampling scale in metres (MODIS MYD13A1 is 500 m).
scale.title: Scale

buffer_m.description: Buffer each segment by this many metres before sampling, to recover NDVI for very short/stationary segments and masked edges. 0 disables.
buffer_m.title: Buffer M

scale_factor.description: Multiply sampled values by this constant. 1.0 keeps raw values. Check your product's documentation for its scale, e.g. MODIS MYD13A1 NDVI/EVI needs 0.0001 to convert raw integers into true NDVI (~ -1..1).
scale_factor.title: Scale Factor

ImageCollectionCovariate.title: Image Collection

StaticImageCovariate.description: One covariate sampled from a single GEE image (e.g. elevation).

name.description: Name for this covariate's column in the output, e.g. 'elevation'.
name.title: Name

image_id.description: Full Earth Engine image asset ID (a path, not a band name), e.g. 'USGS/SRTMGL1_003'.
image_id.title: Image Id

band.description: Band to sample from the image, e.g. 'elevation'.
band.title: Band

reducer.description: Spatial reducer: how the pixels under each (buffered) segment are combined into one value (mean, median, mode, min, max, sum, stdDev, first).
reducer.title: Spatial Reducer

scale.description: Sampling scale in metres; the image's native resolution is a good default (SRTM is 30 m).
scale.title: Scale

buffer_m.description: Buffer each segment by this many metres before sampling, to recover values for very short/stationary segments. 0 disables.
buffer_m.title: Buffer M

scale_factor.description: Multiply sampled values by this constant (e.g. to apply a product's scale). 1.0 keeps raw values.
scale_factor.title: Scale Factor

StaticImageCovariate.title: Image
